_readme: Per-target descriptor table for the extension hook translator (spec 0179 issue #1005, plan step 5) and the MCP translator (spec 0180 issue #1006, PLAN v5 step 3). Each row is the RENDER's own knowledge of one target: the shell tool name its neutral matcher class resolves to, its time-limit unit/default, its extension-root token form, the hook file it reads, its match-all matcher form, and (added by #1006) whether it receives an MCP declaration at all. OPEN ROW SET: sibling ticket #1007 (spec 0181) adds further COLUMNS (commandRef, skillRef, contextOutput) to these same four rows rather than recreating this file — do not delete or rename an existing key without checking that ticket. BOUNDARY (do not blur): this file carries per-target CONSTANTS only. The neutral-event-to-target-event VOCABULARY MAPPING stays in scripts/lib/extension-hooks.sh, never here (see that file's own header for the two reasons). NOTE ON `rootToken` FOR ANTIGRAVITY: the hook translator (scripts/lib/extension-hooks.sh) and the MCP translator (scripts/lib/extension-manifest.sh's ext_mcp_native) give Antigravity's `rootToken: null` OPPOSITE meanings, because Antigravity's own process CWD at spawn time differs by subject — evidenced in docs/runbooks/extension-mcp-token-probe.md. Hooks fire with the plugin directory as CWD, so null there means 'strip the token, a relative command resolves.' MCP servers spawn with the CLI's OWN launch directory as CWD, so null there means 'leave the token UNRESOLVED for install-time rewriting' (scripts/install-antigravity-extension.sh). This is one JSON value read two different ways by two different callers, not a shared fact — do not try to unify it into one behaviour.
